reference.question: If \(a=-1\), find the value of \(a^{2025}-a^{2026}+a^2\).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Substitution and signs of powers

\(a^{2025}=-1\), \(a^{2026}=1\), and \(a^2=1\), so \(-1-1+1=-1\).
